components.name: Primary Action Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #185ABD; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 9px 16px; font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; border: 1px solid #185ABD; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #124A9F; border-color: #124A9F; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #20242B; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #0F3E87; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Search available key actions by name.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" placeholder="搜尋功能，例如 F13、截圖、靜音" aria-label="搜尋按鍵功能">
components.css: .ds-input-search { background: #FFFFFF; color: #20242B; padding: 9px 12px; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; border: 1px solid #D5DBE3; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #185ABD; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #185ABD; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: #55606D; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Choose one of the five keyboard workbench pages.
components.html: <nav class="ds-navigation" aria-label="主要導覽"><button class="ds-nav-item ds-nav-item-selected">按鍵重設</button><button class="ds-nav-item">燈效</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-navigation { background: #F7F8FA; color: #20242B; padding: 8px; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: transparent; color: #20242B; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font: inherit; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #E3E7ED; } .ds-nav-item-selected { background: #DCEAFF; color: #185ABD; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #185ABD; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Selected Keyboard Key
components.description: Marks the physical key currently selected for editing.
components.css: .ds-key { background: #FFFFFF; color: #20242B; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #D5DBE3; border-radius: 5px; font: 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-key:hover { border-color: #185ABD; } .ds-key-selected { background: #185ABD; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #185ABD; } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #20242B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pending Keyboard Key
components.description: Shows a physical key with a staged mapping change.
components.css: .ds-key-pending { background: #DCEAFF; color: #20242B; padding: 6px 8px; border: 2px solid #185ABD; border-radius: 5px; font: 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-key-pending:hover { background: #C9DDFA; } .ds-key-pending:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #20242B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Assignment Strip
components.description: Pairs the current mapping with the proposed action and editing controls.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-assignment { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.8fr 1.2fr; gap: 24px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #20242B; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #D5DBE3; border-radius: 8px; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-assignment span { display: block; color: #55606D; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-assignment strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-assignment input { width: 100%; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #D5DBE3; border-radius: 4px; font: inherit; } .ds-assignment input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #185ABD; outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
This Windows-native interface treats the physical keyboard as the work surface. A quiet porcelain canvas and graphite text keep attention on the key map; restrained blue marks selection and the next committed action. Traditional Chinese labels are direct and compact, with status and controls carrying the workflow instead of promotional copy.

Fluent controls retain their familiar keyboard focus and interaction states. The integrated title bar keeps native caption controls, while the large keyboard, current-versus-proposed assignment strip, and staged changes make editing legible at a glance.
keyCharacteristics: Native WinUI 3 controls and Fluent focus affordances
Blue means selected; pale blue means pending
Large physical keyboard map with an explicit knob test affordance

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies the selected key; pale blue identifies a pending mapping. Keep those meanings distinct.

dos: Do retain native WinUI controls and their Fluent focus behavior.
Do distinguish the selected key from staged edits using the established blue and pale blue states.
Do keep current assignment and proposed action visibly adjacent in the assignment strip.
donts: Don't assign a key meaning to the knob from its physical position; it opens key testing.
Don't replace the neutral workbench with decorative dashboard cards or marketing copy.
